claim: Try the product in one click with sample data that never enters real storage.
sandbox: fresh browser context; enter from landing; inspect storage; search; reset; leave demo

claim: Archive processing makes no network connections and writes mail data only to the chosen archive folder.
where: landing facts and privacy section, /privacy, desktop About, README
sandbox: clean XDG profile; production Tauri binary under xvfb and process-level connect/sendto tracing; shipped MBOX imported and reopened through production IPC; assert zero AF_INET/AF_INET6 connections, unchanged source, local archive outputs, rendered result, no auth state

claim: Imports a standard MBOX mail export and records every decoded or failed attachment reference.
where: landing how-it-works, desktop empty state, README
sandbox: mixed-success MBOX through the import command; assert the reopened manifest keeps both references and the decode failure

claim: Rejects MBOX exports over 256 MB before reading them into memory.
sandbox: sparse 256 MB plus one byte MBOX; assert a clear split-and-retry error before parsing

claim: Hashes attachment bytes with SHA-256 and stores identical files once while retaining both references.
sandbox: temporary MBOX with two references to the same bytes; assert two records and one stored payload

claim: A full encrypted-archive scan checks files after you enter the passphrase, never stores it, and reports damaged stored files.
where: desktop verification panel, privacy page, README
sandbox: temporary encrypted archive; inspect manifest; reopen; scan; mutate stored bytes; reject wrong passphrase; rescan and assert report

claim: Attachments stay inert in hash-named storage, and restoration verifies SHA-256 before writing the destination.
sandbox: temporary archive; assert inert path; restore known bytes; damage stored object; assert next destination is not written

claim: Exports CSV and JSON verification reports with attachment records and failures.
sandbox: fresh demo; download JSON from the visible Export JSON control and parse all records and failures

claim: The sample resolves three of four references, shows one duplicate, and keeps one decode failure visible.
sandbox: fresh /demo state; assert exact counts and visible status evidence

claim: The demo exports its complete verification report as CSV.
sandbox: fresh /demo state; download CSV and assert header, four reference rows, and one issue row

claim: Searches attachment filenames, senders, subjects, and checksums and filters by status.
sandbox: fresh /demo state; search by sender and filter to duplicate status

claim: Archive Plus costs US $29 once and opens a Dodo-hosted checkout through Sociobot.
sandbox: fresh landing page; assert the visible price and URL; request the live gateway without following redirects; require HTTP 303 to a hosted Dodo checkout session

claim: A valid Archive Plus license enables saved recent archive shortcuts and a compact attachment ledger; a revoked license hides both.
sandbox: clean production Tauri binary; use recorded valid and revoked license verdicts around a shipped MBOX import; assert the recent shortcut reopens the archive, Compact changes the ledger, then both controls disappear after revocation

claim: Import, reopen, encryption, restoration, and CSV or JSON verification report export remain available without a license.
sandbox: clean XDG profile and production Tauri binary; no token; drive shipped command bridge and rendered UI through encrypted import, reopen, passphrase scan, checksum restoration, CSV export, and JSON export; assert visible success and files

claim: The app stores attachments without opening them.
where: README security section and desktop empty state
sandbox: temporary MBOX with a sentinel attachment; import and assert stored bytes and report are written without an opener command

claim: Only a license token is sent for verification, at most once per day, and the token is stripped from the return URL.
where: privacy page and Archive Plus restore flow
sandbox: memory-only storage and mocked billing response; capture URL token and call verification twice

claim: A revoked license no longer enables Archive Plus.
sandbox: recorded valid then revoked Sociobot gateway fixtures in memory-only storage; assert cached Plus verdict changes from enabled to locked

claim: The website and isolated demo set no tracking cookies and load no third-party scripts, fonts, pixels, or analytics.
sandbox: fresh browser context; record every landing and demo request, all cookies, and localStorage; assert same-origin requests, zero cookies, and only demo namespace

claim: The release manifest lists macOS ARM and Intel, Windows, Linux AppImage, and Linux DEB downloads with SHA-256 values.
sandbox: parse the shipped same-origin manifest and validate platform URLs and checksums

claim: The macOS/Linux and Windows one-line installers verify SHA-256 before installing.
sandbox: inspect both shipped installer scripts for manifest lookup, SHA-256 comparison, and fail-closed behavior

claim: The Linux AppImage is built on Ubuntu 22.04+.
sandbox: inspect the release workflow Linux matrix and the visible download note

claim: Reopening a plain archive rechecks stored files and records corruption in its verification report.
sandbox: temporary plain archive; mutate a stored payload; reopen it; assert corrupt status and checksum mismatch in both returned manifest and saved JSON report

claim: A v* release workflow builds macOS, Windows, AppImage, and DEB assets and publishes SHA256SUMS and latest.json.
sandbox: inspect the checked-in release workflow for all four target entries, Tauri target build, manifest generation, and release upload of both verification files

claim: The deployed manifest, published release, checksums, and installers identify the same tagged source.
sandbox: recorded release API, manifest, checksum, and installer responses; reject a stale live source commit
